edits.value: A merchant creates a bundle via the admin form; the backend persists the bundle record (including its discount tiers), creates the corresponding code-based discount in Shopify (percentage via discountCodeBasicCreate, flat via discountCodeBasicCreate, or BXGY via discountCodeBxgyCreate), and stores both the returned Shopify discount node id and the generated code string on the bundle record. When the merchant edits or deletes a bundle, the backend syncs the change to the Shopify discount code accordingly. On the storefront, the widget loads eligible bundles for the current product page via a GET, the customer configures their selection, and on "Add Bundle to Cart" the backend receives the selection, computes the best-match tier, adds all line items to the Shopify cart via the Storefront Cart API using cartLinesAdd, then applies the bundle's stored discount code string to the cart via cartDiscountCodesUpdate so it auto-applies at checkout. An orders/create webhook fires when a Shopify order is placed; the backend matches each code in the order's discount_codes[].code array against the stored discount_code_string on bundle records and, for each match, inserts a deduplication row in bundle_order_increments and increments the bundle's purchase count. Products updates and deletions are also captured via webhooks so that bundle-item availability flags stay current without the widget relying solely on stale cached data.
